words.name: percent
words.description: A percentage is a number or ratio expressed as a fraction of 100; the percent measure auto-scales, so a formula that produces a ratio is shown to the user as a percent without multiplying by 100.

words.name: b
words.description: the symbol used in formulas for billion

words.name: factor
words.description: how many times bigger one number is than the number it is compared with

words.name: x
words.description: the symbol shown behind a number that is a factor

formulas.name: scale thousand to one
formulas.description: convert numbers in thousands to one and back, so that a value given in thousands can be compared and calculated with values given in ones

formulas.name: scale million to one
formulas.description: convert numbers in millions to one and back

formulas.name: scale billion to one
formulas.description: convert numbers in billions (thousand millions) to one and back, so that a value given in billions can be compared and calculated with values given in ones
